scientific_change: Explicitly require inverse images under multiplication of all Borel subsets of G to lie in B(G) tensor B(G). This is a necessary measurability/type hypothesis for the product-sigma-algebra argument, not a claim that all compact groups satisfy it. General compact topological groups meeting that condition remain admitted; finite-dimensional Lie is only an in-particular verification.
proof_changes: Facts/Given specify all finite product sigma-algebras and joint-measurability A2; inversion is Borel by continuity.
F1/F2 identify the Statement conventions without deriving a generic group from finite-Lie data. F3 is scoped to the finite-Lie instance.
New Proof1.2 proves the extra condition for that finite-Lie instance using continuity and second-countable product-Borel equality.
Proof3.1 composes measurable inversion/pairing/multiplication with bounded Borel functions, proves finite-word measurability and a bimeasurable tree coordinate map, then uses probability Fubini.
Proof4.1 applies finite-word measurability to both directions of the triangular row bijection. The algebra, Haar preservation and positive-weight normalization remain unchanged.
unchanged: Source frontmatter, deps, dependency_roles and axiom_base; finite rectangle, free boundary, face-word conventions, density and probability conclusions; all three consumer sources; all workflow code, receipts, state, readiness and authority.

consumer_checks.actual_use: Statement fixes SU(2) with finite free-boundary lattice and 0<beta<=1. Proof1.1 checks the positive class weight, and2.1–3.1 use the tree-gauge plaquette law for a gauge-invariant Wilson loop. SU(2) is a finite-dimensional second-countable Lie group, so the existing product-Borel lemma verifies the proposed measurable-multiplication premise; no theorem/example change is proposed.
Example fixes one free-boundary SU(2) square. Facts F3/F5 and Verification1.1–2.1 use the normalized one-plaquette law and gauge-invariant trace. The same SU(2) measurability specialization applies.

Example fixes a two-plaquette SU(2) rectangle. Verification1.1 uses the area-law supplier at A=2;2.1 squares the supplied small-beta expansion. It inherits the preceding SU(2) specialization, not a nonmetrizable-group instance.

scope_limits: The Statement now requires explicit joint product-Borel measurability; it does not prove this for unrestricted compact groups. Full AC, general Radon-product theory and continuum physics claims were not introduced. The three current SU(2) consumers were rechecked by the same repair owner and need no edits.
